lines: How these fake screen recordings work
Everything in this video is synthesized: no screen was actually recorded.
Windows, cursor, typing, and zooms are all rendered from one scenario file.
An AI agent writes the scenario — the engine animates everything.
1. Open an app (window appears, the background blurs)
2. Zoom into the work area to keep the viewer focused
3. Type the content, click the button, done
Every motion is derived from an action. No hand-written keyframes.
